meta.ai_assistance: Produced by notebooks written with AI assistance (Claude, Anthropic) and run by the Field Shift team in Google Colab with Google Earth Engine. Data values come from the cited datasets and were not written by the AI, except a few published values from the trial at the demo field (its station's rain and temperature, and its soil description), which were copied by hand from Denora et al. (2025) and are labelled as such.

field.name: Demo field, Genzano di Lucania
field.about: Vetch and durum trial field of Denora et al. (2025), La Generale cooperative
field.outline_source: drawn by hand on satellite imagery

greenness.about: Greenness (NDVI): about 0.2 = bare soil, 0.8 = thick healthy crop. Days are counted from 1 September; a season is named by its harvest year. 'nearby' = rain-fed arable land within 5 km (MODIS) or 3 km (HLS, Sentinel-2).

calendar.shape: 12 months (Jan-Dec) x [low, typical, high] = 10th percentile, median, 90th percentile of monthly means over 2001-2020

greenness.nearby_gap_note: peak_vs_nearby = this field's peak minus the peak of nearby rain-fed fields (MODIS). Judge a season by peak_vs_nearby_z, how far it departs from the field's usual gap, not by the raw gap.
greenness.dates_note: green-up and dry-off are the days greenness passes half-way between its autumn low and its peak, found between the 16-day MODIS composites (about a week either way); peak_day is the composite with the highest value.

weather.about: Rain = median of CHIRPS, IMERG and ERA5-Land (GSMaP and POWER shown for comparison). Temperature = ERA5-Land (POWER for comparison). Hot day: 30 °C or more; frost night: 0 °C or less; flowering window 15 April to 15 June; autumn = October-November; season = October-May; spring = March-May; days counted from 1 September.

agreement.note: rain_year_by_source = typical September-August rain over the normal years (main three sources); rain_year_common_seasons = average over the seasons every source covers; spread = largest / smallest - 1 for CHIRPS, IMERG and ERA5-Land; removed_months = GSMaP or POWER months dropped as impossible

ground_check.what: Satellite rain (median of CHIRPS, IMERG, ERA5-Land) and ERA5-Land temperature at the demo field, checked against the weather station of the vetch trial at the same field

station.cite: Denora M. et al. (2025). Durum wheat-vetch intercropping in Mediterranean agroecological systems: effects on yield, nitrogen balance, and farm profitability. Italian Journal of Agronomy 20, 100045. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijagro.2025.100045
station.where: weather station at the trial site, La Generale cooperative, Genzano di Lucania (40.82460 N, 16.09348 E)
station.note: station values copied by hand from the paper; used only as a check

ground_check.windows: the paper does not say which months its season totals cover, so three windows are shown; part months are counted by their share of days

water.about: ET0 = FAO-56 Penman-Monteith reference evapotranspiration from ERA5-Land, mm. Durum need = ET0 x FAO-56 crop factor from sowing on 15 November for 240 days. Water use = MODIS actual evapotranspiration, November-June. Soil moisture = SMAP root zone (0-100 cm) as % volume: sowing = November, spring = March-April.

future.about: Change by 2041-2060 against each model's 2001-2020 (historical run to 2014, then SSP2-4.5), added to today's typical value for the same years from notebook 03 (the delta method). Temperatures and counts: difference; rain: percentage change. low / typical / high = 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile across the models.

indicators.hot: hot days (30 °C or more) from 15 April to 15 June

soil.about: SoilGrids 2.0 prediction at the field's centre (250 m). Topsoil = 0-30 cm. Water-holding capacity = top metre. A prediction, not a measurement: check with a soil test.
soil.trial_reported: clay loam, pH about 8.2, total nitrogen about 0.9 g/kg, CEC about 21.3 cmol(c)/kg (Denora et al. 2025, typed in from the paper)
